title: Plant Warning Signs & Crane Safety: Can & Must
description: Interpret shopfloor safety signs, overhead crane operating limits, and mandatory PPE rules using modal verbs.
learning_objectives: Use modal 'must' for mandatory safety regulations
Use 'must not' for strict prohibitions vs 'don't have to'
Use 'can / can't' for crane and hoist weight capacities

questions.prompt: All visitors _____ wear safety boots and a high-visibility vest in the assembly plant.

explanations.correct: Modal 'must' is followed directly by bare infinitive: 'must wear'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Všichni musí nosit'. Never say *must to wear*. Use 'must wear'.

questions.prompt: This overhead workshop crane _____ lift up to 15 metric tons safely.

explanations.correct: Capability modal 'can' takes no -s and takes bare infinitive: 'can lift'.
explanations.wrong_D: Modal verbs do not take 3rd person -s.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Jeřáb může zvednout'. Modal 'can' never takes -s: 'can lift'.

questions.prompt: You _____ stand under a suspended load while the chassis is being transported!

explanations.wrong_B: 'don't have to' means optional ('nemusíte'), which is a fatal error under a crane!

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Nesmíte stát pod břemenem' = 'must not stand'. Do not confuse with 'don't have to' (nemusíte).

questions.prompt: Contractors _____ sign in at the security gate before entering the manufacturing zone.

explanations.correct: Mandatory rule takes 'must + base verb': 'must sign in'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'are' cannot pair with base verb 'sign in'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Musí se zapsat'. Use 'must sign in'.

questions.prompt: _____ we operate the overhead gantry crane without a certified signalman?

explanations.wrong_A: 'Must we operate' asks about compulsion, not permission.
explanations.wrong_B: 'Do we operate' asks about habitual routine.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Můžeme obsluhovat jeřáb bez...?'. Use 'Can we operate...'.

questions.prompt: You _____ wear ear defenders in the stamping hall; the noise exceeds 90 dB.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Musíte nosit ochranu sluchu'. Mandatory rule takes 'must wear'.

questions.prompt: The forklift truck _____ exceed 10 km/h inside the pedestrian crossway areas.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Vysokozdvižný vozík nesmí překročit...'. Prohibition takes 'must not exceed'.

questions.prompt: Employees _____ report all oil spills immediately to the environmental safety officer.

explanations.correct: Obligation modal 'must' is followed directly by bare infinitive: 'must report'.

questions.prompt: You _____ touch electrical control panels with wet hands under any circumstances.

explanations.correct: Prohibition takes 'must not'. Note that *don't must* does not exist in English.
explanations.wrong_B: 'don't must' is a frequent Czenglish grammatical error.

questions.cz_learning_point: Never say *don't must*. English prohibition is strictly 'must not'.

questions.prompt: Only certified crane technicians _____ perform routine wire rope maintenance.

explanations.correct: Capability/authorization modal takes base form: 'can perform'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Pouze certifikovaní technici mohou provádět...'. Modal 'can' takes bare verb: 'can perform'.
